sections.heading: Examining Bodies
sections.body: PTI is an approved examination center for the Uganda Business and Technical Examinations Board (UBTEB) — UBT125 for Technical courses and UBB093 for Business courses — and MAC127 for the Directorate of Industrial Training (DIT).

sections.heading: Industrial Attachment Partners
sections.body: Every trainee is placed with an industry or workplace partner for a minimum of 9 months of supervised, hands-on industrial attachment, graduating with a testimonial from that organisation alongside their DIT and UBTEB certificates.

sections.heading: Global Technology Partnerships (in progress)
sections.body: PTI is pursuing accreditation and partnership pathways with Cisco Networking Academy, IBM SkillsBuild, and Coursera to give Technology & ICT trainees access to internationally recognized certifications alongside their National Certificate, plus university MOUs for degree top-up routes and membership in the UNEVOC Network.
